To use it, install it in a terminal with `curl -fsSL https://openajar.com/install.sh | sh`, then run `openajar setup`. openajar gives the agent its own computer (a VM with a terminal and a real browser), so setup asks for a Hetzner Cloud token, or uses Docker running on this computer: one of the two is needed. Then start the agent again. Docs: https://github.com/sabalys-ramunas/openajar
